To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the TXOP facility is an effective means to improve the performance of the video streams by reducing the transmission delays for the video frames, however, the TXOP facility does not improve the performance of audio streams.

the TXOP parameter can be used to improve the performance of video streams and the use of the TXOP parameter is more efficient when it is used to provide differentiated service to I, P, B video frames.
The TXOP facility can be used to improve the performance of the video stream in parallel multimedia streaming sessions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of the TXOP parameter to improve the performance of multimedia streaming applications over IEEE 802.
the performance improvement of multimedia traffic through the use of TXOP.
the efficient transmission of parallel multimedia streams over the IEEE 802,11e WLAN network.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of the TXOP facility can significantly reduce the transmission delay of parallel video streams and that the performance of the other traffic streams is not affected by the use of the facility.
there is a definite performance improvement for the transmission of parallel video streams by using a combination of the TXOP and differentiated service facilities.
the TXOP facility can be efficiently used to enhance the transmission performance for video streams in a WLAN environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there is significant improvement in the performance of the video streams by dimensioning the TXOPlimit parameter to match the size of the largest burst and providing differentiated service to I, P, B video frame types.
the TXOP facility can be used effectively to improve the performance of the video frames in a parallel multimedia streaming session.
the use of the TXOP facility in conjunction with the differentiated service provided by the I, P, B video frame types is the best way to efficiently reserve bandwidth for parallel multimedia streams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the IEEE 802. 11e WLANs are well suited for the transmission of parallel video streams.

the TXOP facility can be used to improve the performance of the video streams by efficiently dimensioning the TXOPlimit parameter and that there is an optimal TXOPLimit value that maximizes the throughput for all traffic streams.
the TXOP facility can be used in a differentiated service fashion by providing differentiated bandwidth reservation to the different traffic streams and frame types.
